description: Every image moves through a pull request validation has to pass. Nothing merges by itself: an app is where people's data lives.

packageRules.description: An app is rehearsed before its version moves: one pull request per app, holding every image its manifest names — a companion moves with its app, never apart.

Over 60,000 tags on ghcr (a variant per accelerator, a build per pull request): Renovate's lookup gives up. Immich requires it at the server's exact version, so the server's pull request says to move it by hand.

prBodyNotes: 🔴 Move `immich-machine-learning` to the same tag, with its digest, in this pull request: Immich refuses a machine-learning service of another version, and Renovate cannot look it up.

customManagers.description: Each image is named as { repo, tag, digest } on one line; `hlb catalog validate` refuses a tag and digest that disagree.
